offers_products.reason: Main offering is marketplace transaction services; software and data tools are secondary, and it doesn't sell vehicles itself.

offers_services.reason: Digital wholesale vehicle marketplaces, floorplan financing, inspections, vehicle shipping and remarketing services for dealers and lenders.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers and sellers are dealers, OEMs, fleets, rental companies and lenders, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are dealers, OEMs, fleet operators, rental companies and financial institutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Per-vehicle transaction fees from repeat dealer users, but volume depends on sales; not mainly contracted or subscription revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fees depend on used-vehicle wholesale volumes and dealer inventory financing, which fall when the economy weakens.

big_ticket.reason: Fees per vehicle transaction are modest and frequent for dealers who trade vehicles constantly.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the digital marketplace platform, technology and financing, not mainly from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves OEMs, rental companies and lenders, but also many independent dealers, so the mix is split.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly digital platforms. Floorplan finance needs capital, but it has no heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Revenue mix between marketplace fees, floorplan financing and other services is judged from general knowledge; the recurring and large-customer answers are uncertain.
